body.intent: Fix Rows on the web roadmap's backlog sometimes 404 when clicked (owner, 2026-11-13: 'Some of the items in the backlog just 404 when I click on them'). Each row links to /changes/<id> (internal/web/roadmap.go:140), but rows from another project (see the roadmap project-filter bug) or change sets the change page cannot read resolve to no page. Wanted: every roadmap row links to a page that exists in the project it belongs to (under /p/<project>/changes/<id>), and a test clicks every row of a two-project root and gets 200.
